justifications.structure: engine.zig/solver.zig/model.zig/report.zig are OS-free and shared by cli.zig, server.zig, state.zig/ui.zig/canvas.zig; store.zig and platform.zig isolate SQLite and web/native glue.
justifications.naming: Helpers are well named (rcmOrder, columnHeights, condense, memberLocal) with doc comments, but solver.zig:solve() is a ~230-line function mixing assembly, load cases, reactions and residuals, and Geometry uses terse fields (mi, mj, ea, ei, c, s).
justifications.errors: solver.ErrorInfo with a Code enum flows via error.ModelError to cli.cmdSolve (exit 2 + JSON), server.respondModelError (422) and state.zig setError (UI text); minor gaps: CLI bad JSON/gen args exit 1 silently, and a few unchecked .? lookups in solve() depend on earlier validation.
justifications.boundary: Unsafe surface is small and contained: store.zig hand-written SQLite externs with SQLITE_TRANSIENT, serialized mode, and finalize via defer; server threads share only App (gpa + serialized store) and the per-request arena; ui.zig wasm exports (echoExport static buffer) are simple, but externs are unwrapped @intCast and sweep/solve use globals (clock_ns, g_io).
justifications.tests: Only three Zig tests (engine.zig cantilever F01 and unstable beam, model.zig generator sizes); no tests for RCM, skyline factor, condensation, springs, releases, store or JSON round trip; correctness rests on the harness fixtures.
justifications.change_resilience: A new load type touches model, validation, solver rhs assembly, reactions/residual, canvas drawing, report/model writers and UI; about 7 places, with the nodal/UDL handling repeated three times in solve() rather than behind one load-vector function.

generated_excluded: SQLite amalgamation (fetched dependency, not in source tree reviewed)
notable: Strength: solver is pure Zig with no OS deps and an injectable clock hook (solver.clock_ns), so the same engine serves CLI, server and wasm.
Strength: single ErrorInfo/Code type maps cleanly to exit code 2, HTTP 422 and UI text; allocation counting wrapper (counting.zig) for stats.
Risk: solve() in solver.zig is one ~230-line function; nodal/UDL loop logic is duplicated for rhs, reactions and residual.
Risk: only three unit tests; solver internals (RCM, skyline LDL, condense) are untested beyond end-to-end harness fixtures.
Minor: server.respondError interpolates detail into JSON unescaped (currently only static strings); /solve returns 400 for malformed JSON while model errors return 422.
